ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black) background and localized high-intensity (white) fields; approximately 65:35 black-to-white distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes. Left lobe features a white patch at the outer tip with dense internal black speckling. Right lobe contains a larger, more contiguous white region extending from the tip toward the mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, clearly delineated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading to sharp distal points, with localized concavity flanking the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast tan/white pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear marks disrupting the white pigmented areas on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustations at both fluke tips causing visible irregularity to the trailing edge contour.
